primary_outcome: E = 1 - sum KL(p_H||p_int) / sum KL(p_H||p_U), next-token at final position; higher is better
steering_selection_rule: strength multiple maximising E of the raw honesty direction on validation (script 13 rule)
multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg within each family below, alpha 0.05

families.A_graded_patch: 21 tests: activation patch at each lambda and layer vs norm-matched Gaussian (one-sided)
families.C1_raw_direction: 3 tests: raw honesty direction (+s) vs Gaussian (one-sided)
families.C2_sae_directions: 27 tests: SAE reconstruction / top-1 / top-10 direction (+s) vs their controls (two-sided)

criteria.H1_latents_mediate: for an architecture at a layer: latent_all BH-adjusted p <= 0.05 in all SAE seeds
criteria.H2_concentration: latent_topk BH-adjusted p <= 0.05 vs activation-matched latents in all SAE seeds; report E(topk)/E(latent_all)
criteria.H3_error_term: descriptive: E(error_term) vs E(latent_all) per architecture and layer (no threshold)
criteria.H4_sign: top-1 latent direction: two-sided BH-adjusted p <= 0.05 with E < control mean at +s in all seeds = replication of the layer-6 "away from honest output" observation; report E at -s beside it
criteria.power: minimum detectable dose from Part A is reported for every layer before any null is interpreted

test_rows: scored once by --phase test; never used for selection
status_of_results: confirmed test result for the pre-registered families; anything else exploratory
